keyword: what happens if i miss the tax deadline
claims: The Failure to File penalty is 5% of unpaid taxes per month, up to 25%.
The Failure to Pay penalty is 0.5% of unpaid taxes per month.
The Late Filing Penalty amounts to 5% of the unpaid tax balance for each month or partial month the return is late, capped at 25%.
The Late Payment Penalty is 0.5% of the unpaid taxes for each month, capped at 25%.
The IRS charges interest around 7% on unpaid taxes.
Interest on unpaid taxes is compounded daily from the deadline.
If a tax return is over 60 days late, the minimum penalty is $525 or 100% of the unpaid tax, whichever is less.
If the IRS owes you money, there is no penalty for filing late.
Taxpayers have only three years to claim a refund.
